<!-- SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: written for Blockbase tests, not copied from 21st.dev -->
Please add this card to the project. Keep the same style as my other cards,
for example: import { Panel } from "@/components/ui/panel" and then render <Panel /> inside the layout.
Do not change the props.

```tsx
quiet-panel.tsx
export function QuietPanel({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <section className="quiet-panel">{children}</section>;
}

demo.tsx
import { QuietPanel } from "@/components/ui/quiet-panel"

export default function Demo() {
  return <QuietPanel>Hello</QuietPanel>;
}
```
